"""Imports at depth: under TYPE_CHECKING, in a function, in a try."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from threetears.evals.shapes import EvalRun
    from threetears.evals.host import EvalServiceError

try:
    from threetears.models import PriceRefresh
except ImportError:  # the providers extra is not installed
    PriceRefresh = None


def launch(run: EvalRun) -> None:
    from threetears.evals.testing import start_run

    start_run(run)


def judge() -> EvalServiceError:
    from threetears.evals.host import run_judge_llm  # the judge seam

    return run_judge_llm()
